text:
Silver Price in 2002
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2002, the LBMA silver price rose 9.1% between 2002-01-31 ($4.28) and 2002-12-31 ($4.67). The highest sampled price was $5.05 in May and the lowest was $4.28 in January. The mean of these observations was $4.60. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
